verdicts.reason: A has clear collisions: the headline's second line 'week' sits on top of the subtitle, and the legal text is crammed directly under it. The YEARLY card's '48' and 'per year' spill out of the dark card onto the light background, where they are almost invisible. B has a strong headline and a prominent CTA, but its price cards are shrunk to postage stamps with unreadable labels, and the plans are reordered (6, 80, 48), so YEARLY no longer sits in the centre. The subtitle and legal copy are squeezed against the right edge at an illegible size, but B at least has no collisions.
